'''Mushrooms''' can be found on the ground in the [[Meadows]], [[Black Forest]] and [[Swamp]]. Picked mushrooms will respawn after 240 minutes, or {{duration|14400}}, at the same place that they were picked. Unlike the case with raspberries and blueberries, which do not return if the plant itself is removed, mushrooms will return if the ground is cleared or even excavated.

Mushrooms are almost negligible as a food, but they are a vital component of some of the best recipes in the later game, as well as being food for tame Boars. Since they cannot be cultivated, and do not grow in large numbers at any one place, it is prudent to save some of them from early in the game for later use.

== Usage ==
=== Building ===
* {{item link|Spice Rack}}

=== Crafting ===
* {{item link|Carrot Soup}}
* {{item link|Serpent Stew}}
* {{item link|Wolf Skewer}}
* {{item link|Mead Base: Berserkir}}

=== Taming ===
* Can be fed to hungry [[Boar]]s to either begin or continue the taming process, or to allow reproduction.

== Gallery ==
<gallery>
Mushroom wild.png|A Mushroom in the Alpha.

== Collection strategies ==
Collecting large quantities of mushrooms can be tedious since they cannot be farmed with a cultivator. However, there are strategies to make mushroom collection more manageable. One of the simplest and most effective methods is to mark mushroom locations on your map. This can be done from the start of the game, helping you plan efficient foraging routes.

Additionally, once you have enough resources to create multiple portals, you can set up "portal chains" for rapid mushroom collection. Start by placing a portal at your base with a short name ending in "1". Travel to an area with a large mushroom patch, link up the first portal, and set up a new portal with the same name ending in "2", and continue to another mushroom-rich area. Repeat this process as many times as needed. Finally, place a return portal at the last location and link it back to your base. This setup allows for quick and easy mushroom collection every 240 minutes.

To keep track of the harvest time, use a pickable ground item near your mushroom portal to act as a timer. Since all ground items respawn every 240 minutes (4 hours), picking up an item at your base after a mushroom harvest will signal when it is time to harvest again once the item reappears.

'''Glowing metal''' was a resource node and used to be found in the placeholder [[Ashlands]] biome and required an [[Iron Pickaxe]] or better to be harvested. 

== Availability ==
It could be mined to yield [[Stone]] and the old version of [[Flametal Ore]]. Flametal ore could be smelted into the old version of [[Flametal]] in a [[Blast Furnace]].

With the [[Ashlands]] update ancient version of Flametal  and Flametal ore have been converted to ''Ancient ore'' and ''Ancient metal''.
<gallery>
Ancient ore.png|The icon of the unfinished Flametal ore (as ''Ancient ore'')
Ancient metal.png|The icon of unfinished Flametal (as ''Ancient metal'')
</gallery>

There are no implemented crafting recipes using Ancient ore.

== Drops ==
Each node could drop:
{{loot table|
{{loot row|item=Flametal Ore|amt=1-2|rate=33.3%}}
{{loot row|item=Stone|amt=1-2|rate=66.7%}}
}}
Each glowing metal deposit had 14 nodes to mine from. On average, one glowing metal deposit would yield about 7 Flametal Ore and about 14 Stone.

== Notes ==
* The [[Flametal Ore]] is found in what appears to be a meteorite.
**When the last node of '''glowing metal''' is mined out, the fire particle effect in the center of the meteorite dissapears.
*Like other metals, [[Flametal Ore]] cannot be teleported.
*'''Glowing metal''' meteorites seem to act as spawners for [[Surtling]]s (typically spawning 4 at a time, with a large gap between spawns).
* Metal deposits do not respawn.
* Glowing metal can still be acquired with the "''spawn flametal"'' [[Developer console|console]] command.

A '''Ruined tower''' can refer to various points [[point of interest]] found in several [[biomes]]. They look like partially destroyed stone towers.

=== [[Abandoned House|Wooden Tower]] ===
Found on the [[Meadows]] biome, built solely with wooden walls. The second floor has a chest containing various loot.

=== [[Abandoned Outpost|Greydwarf Tower]] ===
Found on the [[Black Forest]] biome, a somewhat complete stone tower with a wooden door and a barrel in front of it. It can also have a rune stone on its side that points toward the location of [[The Elder|The Elder's]] sacrificial altar. This tower variant is guarded by a pack of [[Greydwarf]]s.

Inside the tower is a loot chest placed under the staircase. Breaking the barrel in front will also drop various materials.

=== [[Abandoned Outpost|Skeleton Tower]] ===
Found on the [[Black Forest]] biome, half of this stone tower has been destroyed. This tower will be guarded by several [[Skeleton]]s. A chest may be found on top of these towers.
[[File:ForestHive.png|border|thumb|Wild Beehive in Destroyed Tower -- LhPUPUwxT2 -393 661]]

=== [[Abandoned Outpost|Destroyed Tower]] ===
Found on the [[Black Forest]] biome, almost completely destroyed leaving only the foundation behind. A pack of [[Greydwarf]]s will be guarding the loot chest that can be found in the middle. These towers occasionally house a wild beehive.

=== [[Abandoned Hut|Swamp Towers]] ===
[[File:Swamp tower hut.jpg|thumb]]
Found in the [[Swamp]]s. Has multiple variations of mostly circular towers. Some can be guarded by [[Body Pile]]s. Also, some are topped huts that can be used as temporary bases or outposts.

=== [[Swamp Runestone Tower]] ===
Found in the [[Swamp]]s. A half-destroyed circular tower that has a runestone pointing to [[Bonemass]]'s altar location. A [[Body Pile]] will be in front of the runestone.

=== [[Mountain Tower]]s ===
Found in the [[Mountain|Mountains]]. They can vary in sizes, and can be quite large compared to other ruined towers. There is usually a somewhat intact tower. [[Skeleton|Skeletons]] can be found here, as well as the occasional [[Moder]] [[Runestone|Vegvisir]].

'''Damage''' is a reduction of an entity's health points. It affects much of the core gameplay mechanics. '''Acorns''' are a seed that can be planted using the [[Cultivator]] to produce new [[Oak]] trees. Once planted, seeds take a few in-game days to grow to full size. Seedlings require a small amount of space directly around where they are planted; if they do not have enough space, they will not grow into full trees.

They are also used to build [[Birds' Nest]]s, which produce [[Feathers]] over time.

'''Eternal Pyres''' are [[Player base|base]] structures used for collecting [[Embers]]. They are similar to [[Wisp Fountain]]s in their function, but do not require it to be dark to attract Embers.

They require a [[Stonecutter]] to be built.

==Usage==
Each Eternal Pyre attracts Ember spirits with a 50% chance every 5 seconds, up to 3 spirits. Each spirit can be picked for one Ember.

==Usage==
Birds' Nest produces a [[Feathers|feather]] every 20 minutes of daylight, up to 4.
